verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.baseten.co/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages that point agents to the full documentation index. A dedicated agent-setup page covers installing a skill and MCP servers so coding agents can search the docs. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents successfully using llms.txt or the agent docs in practice.
